messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Does metformin work for weight loss?:
Yes. Metformin can lead to a modest weight loss, though results vary, and it's generally smaller amount of weight loss than what's seen with medications specifically approved for weight loss.
In the landmark Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP), a randomized controlled trial in people at high risk for diabetes, participants taking metformin lost more weight than those on placebo. Metformin patients lost 2.7% of body weight after one year, compared to 0.43% for placebo, and 2.1% after two years compared to essentially no change (0.02%) for placebo. Looking at it another way, 29% of people on metformin lost at least 5% of their starting body weight after one year, versus just 13% on placebo, a gap that held up at the two-year mark (26% vs. 14%).
Metformin is not FDA-approved for weight loss.
Triplet: ["metformin", "has weight loss outcome", "13% of placebo patients lost at least 5% body weight after one year"]

The relation 'has weight loss outcome' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with specific weight loss results in clinical studies, including percentage of body weight lost over time and proportions of patients achieving significant weight reduction.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in combination with': The subject drug is used together with the other treatment or lifestyle measure specified by the object entity.
B. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
C. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
D. 'may require dose adjustment': The subject medication might need a change in dosage under certain conditions or over time.
E. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
